description: Every limit #11's quality gates and #19's computed contrast gate use (AC5). quality/thresholds.ts validates this file with zod, and gate code reads its limits only from here: pnpm check:appearance hands the contrast and focus limits to #19's gate, whose browser default, GATE_TARGETS, a test holds to this file. #6's budgets stay in runtime-budgets.json.

conformance.description: WCAG 2.2 AA for public portfolios, both Studios, and every shipping pack, the same in every tier. axe runs these tags.

contrast.description: Contrast ratios, measured at rendered size. Large text is 18pt (24px), or 14pt (18.66px) at weight 700 or more. highContrast holds under displayMode: high-contrast and prefers-contrast: more. print is on white paper with backgrounds removed, unless print-color-adjust: exact is set. A textured design language raises the targets on canvas and surfaces by textureRaise, while pairs on fills keep theirs (#19).

focus.description: Non-text focus contrast is contrast.nonText against adjacent colors. The focus change covers at least perimeterPx, in CSS px, also under forced colors.

targets.description: Target sizes in CSS px, measured on the padded hit area by hit-testing. minimumPx everywhere (2.5.8: its spacing exception allowed, inline text links exempt). narrowPx for non-inline targets at narrowMaxWidth or narrower. primaryPx at any density for fixed or sticky controls, computed on the control or an ancestor, and for primary touch controls: those inside the #19 Navigation primitive, or in a registration's primaryActions.

viewports.description: Each is WIDTHxHEIGHT in CSS px. every runs for every check, occlusionAndTargets adds a landscape phone for occlusion and targets, reflow is the narrow reflow check, zoom is 200% zoom by deviceScaleFactor, rootText is 200% root text, and textSpacing is where the 1.4.12 override runs.

textSpacing.description: The 1.4.12 override, in multiples of the font size: line height, paragraph spacing, letter spacing, and word spacing.

reducedMotion.description: While motion is reduced, static, hidden, or offscreen: no animated transform, scale, rotate, or position; opacity and color transitions up to transitionMs; and at most rafCallbacks requestAnimationFrame callbacks from rafWindowMs[0] to rafWindowMs[1] after load.

vitals.description: Lab vitals, for every tier. TBT stands in for INP. A canvas-led cell, with a canvas in the first viewport, makes a server-rendered poster image or headline text its LCP element within lcpMs. A missing LCP entry fails.

idle.description: TaskDuration over windowMs, starting startMs after load, visible, at default motion, on the default path, by performanceTier. The forced software-WebGL path is report-only.

memory.description: JSHeapUsedSize at sampleMs, in MiB (1,048,576 bytes), by performanceTier, and its growth from growthWindowMs[0] to growthWindowMs[1].

timing.description: Vitals, idle work, and memory take the median of runs. Pull request and scheduled runs report it as a trend. Release-candidate runs fail a median more than releaseTolerance over its ceiling.

exceptions.description: An exception expires at most maxDays after it's created, and a flake quarantine at most quarantineMaxDays after. Scheduled runs warn warnDays before an exception expires.

flakes.description: limit flakes of one test within windowDays fail scheduled and main runs, unless a quarantine exception owned by the surface's owner exists. Pull request runs only report flakes.
